review_type: Independent static source review. No compile, query, result calculation, GT decode, vector read or heavy data hashing. Python sources were parsed as syntax trees only.
resolved_findings: Owned subprocess finally now covers polling/state-write/assert/timeout/interrupt failures, terminates and waits with kill fallback, sets active=None, persists cleanup and logs a persistence fallback; only its own proc is targeted.

Evaluation requires native-complete serial-supervisor status, active=None and four successful native exits before large hashes or role GT decode, and prescans every frozen point receipt before GT decoding.
Cross-L round-index speed ratios now explicitly state descriptive noncontemporaneous/nonrandom pairing and report speed-range separation; same-L ratios refer to sequential matched KL rounds.

Mechanism output now reads all-n frozen 128-word candidate traces, validates ID domains/uniqueness/disjointness/seed source/caps and checks M5 new rescues originate in X; U/teacher outside-support is counted from existing frozen ID sets.
Benchmark trace and evaluator both use seed3/nC/nX/nSeeds/m5_committed/extension_aborted/C24/X96 layout, not the earlier status/plannedNc proposal.
CandidateAudit and original packet allocations/writes are confined to independent untimed audit, rather than default-initialized on the timed path.
parameter_and_execution_checks: Four jobs, actual K1/K100, two L/dataset, pilot nine methods and confirmation five methods are prelocked before new responses; 72+40=112 point enumeration and three timed repeats give336 batches.
Parameter lock binds protocol and each job SHA; serial runner binds execution source/binary SHA and data-preflight/acceptance before launch, with large-input stat guards only during serial jobs.
No fit/training, response-driven parameter replacement or confirmation cancellation branch is present. Confirmation vectors/GT admin identity are distinct from quality decoding.
CPU15 and one actual thread are asserted in native batch schedule/resource guards and monitored by the owning serial runner; no concurrent child launch is present.
analysis_checks: Returned ID uniqueness/domain/padding, GTK uniqueness/domain and aligned hit/member arrays are checked; rescue-damage equals integer quality delta.
QPS uses n divided by three finite positive complete batch walls, retains all three ratios and range; positive integer delta plus median ratio is labeled observed joint gain rather than replacement.

Histogram multinomial bootstrap is equivalent to resampling query hit deltas, with stable key seed and2000 draws; intervals are explicitly descriptive without semantic IID or simultaneous/multiple-comparison guarantee.
TRAIN teacher support is read only after all native completion gates and checked against original compile-manifest SHA; support is ID incidence, not a bridge-effect or geometry proof.
Region traces are all4096 whereas NDC and count/plain parity are fixed256; outside-U candidate/member incidence is separate from actual final rescue/damage.
benchmark_checks: timed_normal_batch starts before Batch allocation/initialization and stops after its scope releases output; run includes normal route, main DC/vt/pool, domain guard, posting, seed/graph work, all scores/merge/output.

Timed path is run(...counting=false,stats=nullptr,independent_audit=false) with no CandidateAudit allocation, fresh oracle DC or trace writes. Timed output publication barrier is followed by destruction, not retained results.
Every point gets three prelocked rotated method rounds and full separate plain returns; loading, serialization, full oracle and counting are outside timed walls.

All-n region replay independently derives original C via sorted-map lookup, recomputes actual R/C/X words with another original scalar DC, derives row seed winners and ordered legal/unseen X, and uses a separate linear worst-slot oracle rather than runtime heap.
Region replay is bit-compared to separately saved all-n plain output and original GT route/profile words. Count wrapper is independently bit-compared only on the fixed uniform256 sample.
Direct controls retain original Posting::apply with an independent linear merge oracle; direct candidate plan shares original plan and is not claimed as independent candidate generation.
extra0 intervention is smoke-only by default; formal output parity is not misrepresented as an additional full extra0 replay. Nonfinite-X oracle checks fallback to complete old M5 packet.
Raw trace saves IDs/status only, while score words are independently checked in untimed memory; timed per-round words are not captured and the receipt says so.
nonblocking_suggestions: Reverify and record the small original M5 posting SHA when evaluating posting_U, rather than relying solely on administrative preflight/frozen-input workflow.
Tail-rank decomposition can be added later as descriptive result analysis without changing prelocked strategies; absence of it does not invalidate quality/QPS computations.
limitations: Static review is not compilation, actual binary/FP qualification, successful run, data-integrity verification or performance evidence; authorized compiler/smoke/native/parity gates still remain.
Three speed rounds and many pointwise descriptive intervals do not prove general/simultaneous dominance or justify default replacement.
Different posting-row sources are not proven distinct basins or a measured modality gap; new X/teacher-outside coverage is not causal proof of cross-modal geometry.
Direct original linear oracle is specified for normal finite-score domain; unsupported nonfinite/trap branches may fail the experiment audit and must not be reported as accepted performance.
No review or hash of large data bytes was performed by this child during this source review.
